name: Product reviews
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Product reviews.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Title
settings.how: Enter the title. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Subheading
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Mode
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Metaobject namespace
settings.how: Advanced: enter the namespace of an existing Shopify metafield definition, such as custom. It must match the definition exactly. Pair it with the corresponding key; this setting does not create a definition.

settings.label: Metaobject key
settings.how: Advanced: enter the existing metafield key or content field key described below. Match the spelling exactly and use the data type expected by this section. Use manual content first if no matching definition exists.

settings.label: Show average rating
settings.how: Turn on “Show average rating” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Show write review button
settings.how: Turn on “Show write review button” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Write review label
settings.how: Enter the write review label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Write review URL
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Rating
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust rating. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Headline
settings.how: Enter the headline. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Quote
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Name
settings.how: Enter the name. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Location
settings.how: Enter the location. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Date
settings.how: Enter the date. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Source
settings.how: Enter the source. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.
